newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries up sharply toward close on tame data.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries up sharply toward close on tame data.

text.p: U.S. Treasury securities prices were sharply higher late Tuesday as market participants breathed relief over tamer-than-expected news on inflation.

The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that employment costs rose 0.6 percent in the first quarter, versus market expectations of a 0.9 percent increase. In addition, durable goods in March dropped 3.0 percent -- the largest falloff since August of last year.
The Treasury's benchmark 30-year bond was trading at 95-17/32 late Tuesday, up 1 18/32 to yield 6.98 percent.
